purpose: Separate relieved expression from normal at dialogue size; remove foreign specks

yupo.prompt: Precise correction to this THREE-PORTRAIT expression strip of one USER-APPROVED character. Preserve image dimensions, the existing THREE equally sized horizontal slots, every character position, head/ear/shoulder size, facing, species, costume, colors, line quality, and shaded pixel-art rendering. LEFT normal and MIDDLE worried portraits must remain visually unchanged. Change ONLY the RIGHTMOST relieved portrait's face: make the eyelids clearly LOWERED / HALF-CLOSED in a gentle relaxed smile (both eyes still recognizable, not fully closed), eyebrows softly at rest, and the mouth a modest warm closed-mouth smile. At small 120x107 game size it must read distinctly calmer than the normal open-eyed portrait, without laughing, tears, teeth, blush, sweat or symbols. Same exact anatomy and lighting. Also clean any isolated foreign specks / fragments in EMPTY SPACE BETWEEN or OUTSIDE portraits; preserve the real connected whiskers and fur outlines. Empty backdrop must stay genuine alpha transparent; no solid or painted checkerboard, no glow or shadow. Keep all three complete ear tips. No new characters, labels or objects. No overall repaint or redesign.
